scope: Official documentation research; selected architecture is not deployment qualification.

sources.supports: Self-contained BEAM/Elixir releases and container packaging.
Bandit HTTP server and Phoenix integration.
Durable SQL jobs, atomic enqueue with domain changes, retry and scheduling features.
Open-source queue concurrency is per node; Mixer requires fleet-level admission.
Default PostgreSQL notifier needs LISTEN/NOTIFY and is unsuitable for transaction poolers.
Transaction pooling has session-feature restrictions including LISTEN/NOTIFY.
Ecto/Postgrex connection and trusted TLS CA configuration.
Production compute availability must be configured for durable queue processing.
Storage redundancy is distinct from interrupted compute/connection recovery.
Linux runtime containers controlled through Workers; Phoenix placement is an architecture inference.
Containers generally available since April 13, 2026.
Direct Durable Object Container API recommended for new applications.
Inactivity timeout needs active management and is bounded; no implicit BEAM job liveness.
Container lifecycle, ephemeral state and routing/recovery boundaries.
GA default service policy; optional durable_object scheduling remains beta.
Native PostgreSQL TCP egress requires separate qualification from HTTP handlers.
Android build resource limits must be exercised before placement acceptance.
Production custom domains, cache rules and private object access boundaries.
Static frontend bundles deployed with Workers.
Official Solid TypeScript app scaffolding and optional full-stack framework.
Solid Router browser routing.
Stripe subscription and invoice lifecycle.
Unmodified-body signature verification, duplicates, unordered events and asynchronous handling.
Retry-safe provider requests; Mixer durable operation ledger remains necessary.

decisions.api: Elixir/OTP + Phoenix + Plug/Bandit in Cloudflare Containers
decisions.queue: Oban OSS + Ecto.Multi on Neon; Mixer-owned quotas, fencing and external-effect reconciliation
decisions.database: Neon direct verified TLS initially, bounded pools, production scale-to-zero disabled
decisions.cloudflare: Workers frontend/edge, R2/CDN payloads, Containers API and qualified Oban/Android roles
decisions.web: SolidJS + TypeScript + Vite + Solid Router, static console deployment
decisions.exceptions: Apple/macOS build hardware, separate signer; external continuously running BEAM/Linux runner if required qualification fails
